episodes.title: Movies are Magic
episodes.description: Explore how motion pictures create convincing illusions and meet some of cinema’s earliest inventors.

episodes.title: The First Movie Camera
episodes.description: Explore Thomas Edison, W. K. L. Dickson, and their contributions to early motion-picture technology.

episodes.title: The Lumiere Brothers
episodes.description: Explore the Lumière brothers’ Cinématographe and the shift toward projecting movies for an audience.

episodes.title: Georges Melies – Master of Illusion
episodes.description: Explore the emergence of cinematic fiction and illusion through Georges Méliès and Alice Guy-Blaché.

episodes.title: The Language of Film
episodes.description: Explore how Edwin S. Porter’s early films helped develop cinema’s visual language.

episodes.title: The Birth of the Feature Film
episodes.description: Trace the transition from short film novelties to features, including the influential and problematic work of D. W. Griffith.

episodes.title: German Expressionism
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Film History, we're going to focus on Germany and how they got a bit expressive with film.

episodes.title: Soviet Montage
episodes.description: Explore post-revolutionary Russian cinema and Soviet montage’s use of juxtaposed images.

episodes.title: The Silent Era
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Film History, we take a look at the Silent Era of Hollywood and people like Charlie Chaplin.

episodes.title: Breaking the Silence
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Film History, Craig Benzine explores how synchronous sound ushered in a new age of cinema.

episodes.title: The Golden Age of Hollywood
episodes.description: Explore Hollywood’s Golden Age, including advances in color and aspect ratio.

episodes.title: Independent Cinema
episodes.description: Trace independent cinema’s emergence as filmmakers in Italy, France, and elsewhere challenged established formulas.

episodes.title: Home Video
episodes.description: As the New Hollywood gained steam in the late 70s and early 80s, another revenue stream opened its doors: home video.

episodes.title: World Cinema – Part 1
episodes.description: Explore influential developments in Asian cinema, including film cultures in Japan, China, and India.

episodes.title: World Cinema – Part 2
episodes.description: Africa, the Middle East, and South America have their own vibrant film communities and filmmakers.

episodes.title: Experimental and Documentary Films
episodes.description: So let's settle in and have a look at how Experimental and Documentary films have evolved.
